description: This Java class 'Timeslotter' categorizes notes based on their modification date into different time slots such as today, yesterday, this week, last week, this month, last month, or a specific year if older. It uses Android's DateUtils for date formatting and interacts with Note entities to determine their time slot labels.

classes.name: Timeslotter
classes.description: A class that manages and categorizes notes into time slots based on their modification date.

methods.name: Timeslotter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the time slots based on the current date and sets up the last year's calendar reference.

methods.name: getTimeslot
methods.description: Returns a string label representing the time slot category for a given note based on its modification date.
